candidate.blueprint_locator: 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan, Management of Care, printed p.7 / PDF p.11
candidate.educational_objective: Use safety-culture survey data appropriately for organizational improvement.

options.A: Identify strengths and areas for improvement in the organization’s patient-safety culture and guide improvement work.
options.B: Use the survey as the sole basis for disciplining individual employees.
options.C: Treat the survey as a diagnostic test for individual clinical competence.
options.D: Ignore unit-level patterns because the survey is not intended for organizational improvement.

candidate.rationale: AHRQ’s Hospital SOPS assesses staff perceptions of patient-safety culture across domains such as teamwork, staffing and work pace, response to error, communication, and handoffs. AHRQ recommends using SOPS results to identify strengths and areas for improvement.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Hospital SOPS measures staff perceptions of patient-safety culture and supports identification of strengths and improvement opportunities.
candidate.source_document_title: SOPS Hospital Survey 2.0; SOPS Frequently Asked Questions
candidate.source_locator: Hospital SOPS purpose and FAQ—assess safety culture; identify strengths and areas for improvement
candidate.source_organization: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality
candidate.stem: A hospital reviews results from the AHRQ Hospital Survey on Patient Safety Culture (SOPS). What is the most appropriate use of these results?
